sections.name: ジャンボソフトパフェ

notes: p5 overall heading is English script 'Round Shape Softcream' (Japanese item names use まんまるソフトパフェ) with two sub-headings GELATO / ICE (431-433) and PUDDING (439-441); used the sub-headings as sections. Could instead be merged as one 'まんまるソフトパフェ' section.
p5 also has a '岡山限定' badge: いちごソフトに変更 +¥300 (an option, not a numbered item).
p3 お茶パフェ: 396 alone on the orange panel; 430/391/429/388 on the green つぼ市製茶本舗 panel (no 抹茶/ほうじ茶 sub-labels unlike abeno).
Mini parfaits 436-438 are on page 10 (outside pages 1-5) under 'Set Parfait セットパフェ all ¥560'.
p2 ジェラートパフェ has decorative Berry ベリー / Mango マンゴー sub-labels.
